purpose: Production training specification, not acceptance data or a row-count target

intervals.rule: Cover every unit within the runtime-admitted semantic domain; enumerate omitted candidate values and reasons. Distinguish parser-domain restrictions from compiler limitations, and never relabel genuine requests as negative speech.

runtimeDomain.dayWeekMonth: No parser upper bound; compiler representability checked separately

weekdayRanges.rule: All 42 directed distinct-endpoint pairs, including week-crossing and full-week ranges, require positive annotated range evidence in every split. Lists or tags alone do not satisfy a range cell.

splitRequirements.relatedRows: All value substitutions, paraphrases and counterfactuals in a source group stay in one split
splitRequirements.perFamily: Distinct reviewed construction groups in train, validation and heldout; no empty or vacuous coverage cells
splitRequirements.independence: Generator-heldout is development evidence, not independently authored final acceptance

sourceRequirements.authorship: Explicit on every record; AI-authored must not be called human or independently reviewed
sourceRequirements.publicText: Pinned source identity, licensing/attribution, source-record traceability, normalized deduplication and protected-text exclusion
sourceRequirements.realRequests: Use consented data if available; otherwise report absence rather than fabricate it
sourceRequirements.review: Review full utterance constructions for grammar, intended action and gold meaning, not just oracle agreement

knownRepresentationGaps.evidence: With gold INTERVAL_LIT on twenty or thirty, oracle decoding emits interval 1 instead of 20 or 30; INTERVAL_12 on twelve succeeds
knownRepresentationGaps.cause: Closed INTERVAL labels cover 2..12; _LIT reads digits, not number words
knownRepresentationGaps.action: Do not generate misleading training labels. Record exclusions and report the representation limitation; do not silently change runtime policy in this corpus goal

knownRepresentationGaps.capability: minute intervals above 59 and hour intervals above 23
knownRepresentationGaps.evidence: The full authored-source audit rejected 1,440 combinations with perfect gold roles; decoder validation reports minute interval must be at most 59 or hour interval must be at most 23
knownRepresentationGaps.cause: Existing runtime validation, not missing corpus examples
knownRepresentationGaps.action: Report the 12 excluded unit/value combinations. Do not change runtime policy, silently rescale the unit, or label those requests as negative speech in this corpus goal.

completion: All supported coverage cells must have verified artifacts and meaningful source diversity; row volume alone cannot satisfy this specification
